pages.observation: The page reads clearly as a Z-pattern of captions. 'A later morning' marks the time jump from page 2. Panel 1 says patients 'can always' use the front desk, and panel 2 says 'Some' use the app. Since Raman and Priya are never named on the page, their link to the two check-in methods depends entirely on the art. Ravi is named only in a caption, which works. In panel 5 the slot label 'A-10 · A-11 · A-12' runs left to right, and the figures raman, priya and ravi also run left to right. This implies Ravi is A-12, but nothing states it. The mapping matters for page 4 ('NOW · A-12', 'his slot'), so it should be made visible in the art, for example on a screen or ticket. No text overflows. Every reaction on the page is silent, so no reply is skipped.
